preview.opening: EXACTLY ONE PERSON. EXACTLY ONE FACE. Single centered identity portrait; never a collage, grid, comparison, or character sheet.
preview.composition: Front-facing head-and-shoulders composition, eyes looking directly at camera, symmetrical neutral pose, centered face, entire head visible.
preview.quality: Realistic facial proportions, detailed natural skin texture, soft even studio lighting, plain neutral-gray background, single-subject studio portrait, sharp focus.
